BiblicalUsage: Tachash was a son of Nahor, Abraham's brother, and the last name in the list of Nahor's children by his concubine Reumah. He is named once, and nothing more is told of him. His name is also the word for the animal whose skins covered the tabernacle, and the two uses share one spelling.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the single mention honours him anyway: a nephew of Abraham, named in the family list, and remembered because the family was remembered.
